text: {"lessons":["Buying more after prices fall can increase exposure without proving a recovery is coming; I should decide in advance how much risk I can take.","Holding five stocks spread my purchases across them, but I should still keep enough cash and avoid committing too much at once.","My account fell in Period 3 and partly recovered while I made no trades in Periods 4 and 5; I should avoid reacting to every monthly move and keep my ten-year goal in view."]}
